items.en_title: Juazeiro (BA) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 25 #018
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Juazeiro (BA) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 2,457,664; proposals close Nov 25, 17:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
